item.title: Graphenea — CVD films and GO lots
item.description:
Evidence: Documented vendor. Lot sizes are small next to powder mills. Methods sections that say “Graphenea GO” are a real paper trail.

Parent list: [[topics/manufacturing/directory]]

Sites

San Sebastián (Spain) and a US shop (Boston area in company copy) for films and oxide.

Products

  • CVD graphene on copper or transferred films.
  • Graphene oxide / rGO in research and small commercial lots.

How to cite

Cite the SKU and lot note in the paper. Do not inflate a research bottle into plant-scale powder.
